title: Reciprocal Composed with a Shift
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Suppose $f(x)=\dfrac{1}{x}$ and $g(x)=x+2$. Find a formula for $(f\circ g)(x)$ and describe the values of $x$ that must be excluded.

steps.title: Set Up the Composite
steps.explanation: The reciprocal rule $f(u)=1/u$ takes $g(x)=x+2$ as its input.
steps.why: Substituting the whole inner expression into the denominator preserves the structure of $f$.

steps.title: Write the Explicit Formula
steps.why: The composite inherits the algebraic form of the outer function.

steps.title: Determine the Excluded Input
steps.explanation: The fraction fails only when its denominator vanishes, i.e. at $x=-2$, so the domain is all reals except $-2$.
steps.why: Reciprocal-type composites break precisely where the outer denominator becomes zero.
